newsitem.title: USA: Intl Custom says to buy Scottco of Dulac.
newsitem.headline: Intl Custom says to buy Scottco of Dulac.

text.p: International Custom Pack Inc said on Friday it reached an agreement-in-principle to buy the business and assets of Scottco of Dulac Inc, a privately held company.

"The acquisition should be a great compliment to our existing operations," said Brent Gutierrez, president of International Custom Pack. "At present production levels, the facility could add another eight to 10 million in revenue in the 1997 fiscal year.
"Looking ahead to potential future growth, Scottco could easily generate an additional $15 to $20 million in sales per fiscal year and could add eight to 10 cents per share to our bottom line."
International Custom Pack also said Jeff Scott, the founder and present owner of Scottco, will oversee operations of the new business.
